parameters.name: router-id
parameters.explanation: LDP协议的Router ID，通常为环回接口地址。

set protocols ldp interface GigabitEther.template: set protocols ldp interface [parameter1] label protocol ldp

set vlans v1 l2transport vc 20 oam-aggre.template: set vlans [parameter1] l2transport vc [parameter2] oam-aggregated ethtype-cm mpp-map md-level [parameter3] md-name [parameter4] ma-name [parameter5]

set vlans v1 l2transport vc 20 oam-aggre.explanation: 配置VLAN的L2传输VC及相关OAM参数。
